info.description:
REST API for user authentication and user management.
Authenticated endpoints need the `access_token` cookie set by `POST /auth/login`. Swagger 2.0 cannot describe cookie auth, so endpoints are not marked as secured here; "Try it out" works because the browser sends the cookie.
info.title: Go net/http Auth Base API

get.description: Lists audit logs with cursor pagination. Requires the `access_token` cookie set by POST /auth/login and the admin role.

post.description: Authenticates with email and password. Sets the `access_token` and `refresh_token` cookies.
Deletes the current session and clears the auth cookies. Requires the `access_token` cookie set by POST /auth/login.
Deletes every session of the user except the current one. Requires the `access_token` cookie set by POST /auth/login.
post.summary: Log out of the other devices

post.description: Rotates the refresh token. Requires the `refresh_token` cookie (path /auth/refresh) and sets new `access_token` and `refresh_token` cookies.
Emails a 6-digit code to the current email address of the user. Valid for 10 minutes, one request per 60 seconds per session. Requires the `access_token` cookie set by POST /auth/login.
Elevates the current session for 5 minutes. A code allows 5 attempts. Requires the `access_token` cookie set by POST /auth/login.

200.description: Session elevated; step_up_until is a unix timestamp

401.description: Invalid code (auth.stepUp.invalidCode), no active challenge (auth.stepUp.noChallenge) or session revoked after too many failures (auth.stepUp.sessionRevoked, clears the auth cookies)

get.description: Handles the provider callback and requires the OAuth flow cookies set by the login step. On success sets the `access_token` and `refresh_token` cookies and redirects to the redirect_uri. If the provider returned an error, redirects to the redirect_uri with `?error=<code>`.

parameters.description: State token issued by the login step
parameters.name: state

parameters.description: Authorization code (required unless error is set)
parameters.name: code

parameters.description: Error code returned by the provider
parameters.name: error

parameters.description: Error description returned by the provider
parameters.name: error_description

get.description: Redirects to the OAuth provider and sets the OAuth flow cookies (nonce and PKCE verifier). The redirect_uri must be in the allow list.

parameters.description: Allowed URI to return to after the login
parameters.name: redirect_uri

post.description: Creates a user and sends the verification email.
Applies the new email using the token from the confirmation link and marks it as verified.

get.description: Requires the `access_token` cookie set by POST /auth/login.

post.description: Sends a confirmation link to the new address; the email only changes after POST /users/confirm-email-change. Requires the `access_token` cookie set by POST /auth/login and a recent step-up (POST /auth/step-up, then POST /auth/step-up/verify).
Always succeeds for unknown or already verified emails.
Confirms the email using the token from the verification link.

get.description: Requires the `access_token` cookie set by POST /auth/login.

put.description: Partially updates a user. The email changes through POST /users/me/email. Requires the `access_token` cookie set by POST /auth/login.

delete.description: Requires the `access_token` cookie set by POST /auth/login and a recent step-up (POST /auth/step-up, then POST /auth/step-up/verify), also for admins.
